subject: [PATCH v6 00/12] Virtual Swap Space (Swap Table Edition)

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch series introduces Virtual Swap Space, a feature that allows for virtual swap space allocation within the Linux kernel. It enables the use of zswap (a compressed block device) as a backing store for virtual swap space, allowing for more efficient use of physical memory and reducing the need for traditional swap partitions. The patches include various cleanups, bug fixes, and improvements to existing code, including changes to cgroup memory statistics and sysctl parameters. The goal is to provide a flexible and scalable solution for managing swap space in modern Linux systems.
